row: North Mountain Animal Sanctuary is a registered charity and farm animal rescue in the Annapolis Valley, Nova Scotia, Canada.  NMAS provided care, comfort, and rehabilitation to abused, neglected, and unwanted farm animals.   At present there are sheep, goats, chickens, pigs, turkeys, rabbits, guinea pigs, hedgehogs, and turtles in care.  For more information or to make a donation, visit our website at www.nmas.ca and follow us on Facebook & Instagram.
